name: My Life as a Teenage Muslim
source:
"My life as a Teenage Muslim" is a family friendly visual novel that focuses on family values and Islam in general. 

You play as Mary, a young Muslim girl, who is starting her new life after moving to an another neighborhood with her mother, Fatima.

[From [url=https://kaf-arts.itch.io/my-life-as-a-teenage-muslim]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《My Life as a Teenage Muslim》是一部适合全家欣赏的视觉小说，主要关注家庭价值观与伊斯兰教。

你将扮演年轻的穆斯林女孩Mary，她与母亲Fatima搬到另一个社区后，正准备开启新的生活。

[摘自[url=https://kaf-arts.itch.io/my-life-as-a-teenage-muslim]itch.io[/url]]
